bundlingNotes: OTIRO is a rate-making bureau under ORS Chapter 737 -- every title insurer authorized in Oregon must file with the Oregon Division of Financial Regulation whether it uses OTIRO rates as-is, OTIRO with deviations, or an independent manual (per DFR form 440-3605). In practice all major underwriters (Stewart, WFG, First American, per their own bulletins) adopt OTIRO's rates unchanged, making this bureau manual a near-complete substitute for a per-underwriter rate survey -- the same bureau-uniform pattern as NCTIRB (NC), OTIRB (OH), and LATISSO (LA). The manual's General Provisions and Commitment conditions (Section 7, 'IF THIS COMMITMENT IS ISSUED BY AN ISSUING AGENT') explicitly state: 'The issuing agent is not the Company's agent for closing, settlement, escrow, or any other purpose' -- confirming escrow/closing/settlement services are entirely outside OTIRO's premium-rate scope and are priced separately by each title/escrow office.
